paragraphs.text: The Aetherworks Marvel is a legendary artifact on the plane of Kaladesh .

The Aetherworks Marvel is a large machine that can generate energy from the aether and use it. It is cylindrical, rising from the floor to the ceiling in the center of its room, and has multiple mechanical arms around it. Its exact purpose is not known but its appearance makes it resemble a form of assembly line where the arms on it serve some purpose for creating or working on objects.
